'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 2 Matt Sokol DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Sokol
* '''Deck name:''' Endor ops
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
